item.title: The Mail Slot Needs a Bouncer.
item.description: Donald turns a public mailbox into a guest-list checkpoint and treats mailed ballots like club entry. Political satire based on public reporting. Dialogue attributed to Donald is invented. Sources: The White House: https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/2025/03/preserving-and-protecting-the-integrity-of-american-elections/ Associated Press: https://apnews.com/article/trump-mail-voting-appeal-executive-order-supreme-court-5482700c21f4945d6991dff24776b525
